_readme: Wisdom Loop Discord sources (§2.1). IDs only — no message text, no member data.
Guild channel IDs resolved 2026-09-13 via GET /guilds/{guild}/channels with the UCT Intelligence bot token (app 1474900505917653142, role 1474903498700230668).

access = the bot's measured result of GET /channels/{id}/messages?limit=1 after the grant (200 = readable). Grants were made in the Discord web UI as a channel permission override on the bot role; required bits were computed from the channel's @everyone overwrite (see grant_bits).
Only messages whose author_id is in docs/wisdom/authors.json are stored; everything else is dropped before any write (§0.4e).

channels.name: main-chat
channels.note: General community chat, NOT author-specific -- but this is where AtTheAsk (owner-named 6th CALL author, 2026-09-19) actually posts, unlike the other five who each have a dedicated channel. AtTheAsk's discord_user_id is still PENDING (2026-09-19): none of the 17 distinct posters in the last 100 messages (checked username AND global_name) obviously matched, so it needs the owner's exact handle before being added to authors.json. Once added, the existing author_id-in-authors.json storage filter (S0.4e) already does the right thing here with no code change -- it keeps only AtTheAsk's own messages out of this noisy channel and drops the other ~16 posters, same mechanism as every dedicated-channel author. Separately open: whether to ALSO broaden capture to other (non-author) members' posts here as MENTION-only content -- not decided, not needed just to capture AtTheAsk. See docs/wisdom/HARD-RULES.md Session 28 note.
